Medium Affected: WATER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.349981, -80.76527 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS THERE IS A SUSPECTED BREACH BETWEEN THE CHEMICAL SEWER AND STORM SEWER AT THE FACILITY. THIS IS CAUSING CONTAMINATION OF THE WATER THAT IS DISCHARGING INTO THE NEW RIVER. THE EXACT COMPOSITION OF THE WATER IS UNKNOWN, BUT IT IS BELIEVED TO OBTAIN ACETIC ACID, AN ANHYDRIDE, AND A CAUSTIC COMPONENT. THE PH IN THE STORM SEWER HAS BEEN TESTED AND IS BETWEEN 9 AND 10. THE PH IS NEUTRAL AT THE OUTFALL INTO THE RIVER. THIS RELEASE IS CREATING A FOAMY PRODUCT ON THE RIVER SURFACE. CALLER ESTIMATES THE OUTFALL IS DISCHARGING THE CONTAMINATED WATER AT ABOUT 40 GALLONS/MINUTE.

properties.summary: Incident Type: CONTINUOUS - NRC Report ID: 878344 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: AIR LIQUIDE INDUSTRIAL US L.P.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 878344
Incident Time: 2008-04-24 15:00:00
Nearest City: Galva, IA
Incident Type: CONTINUOUS
Material: AMMONIA, ANHYDROUS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: AIR LIQUIDE INDUSTRIAL US L.P.
Skytruth Analysis
ON APR 24,2008 THE AMMONIA CONDENSER WAS SHUT DOWN DUE TO AN ODOR THAT WAS DETECTED IN A ROUTINE INVESTIGATION. THE SOURCE OF THE LEAK WAS IDENTIFIED AND BLOCKED AND THAT COIL WAS TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE. BASED ON PRELIMINARY CALCULATIONS THE LEAK WAS BELOW 89 LBS WITHIN A 24 HOUR PERIOD AND THE REMAINING COIL WAS RESTARTED. IN AN AUDIT OF THE AMMONIA CONDENSER ON JULY 1,2008 IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE AMOUNT OF THE PAST AMMONIA RELEASE MAY HAVE TOTALED 443 POUNDS PER DAY. THE UNIT WAS ALREADY SHUT DOWN FOR MAINTENANCE WHEN THE REVISED EMISSION AMOUNTS WERE DISCOVERED. THE REMAINING COIL WAS ISOLATED AND THE AMMONIA WAS EVACUATED FROM THE SYSTEM.

BASED ON PRELIMINARY CALCULATIONS THE LEAK WAS BELOW 89 LBS WITHIN A 24 HOUR PERIOD AND THE REMAINING COIL WAS RESTARTED. IN AN AUDIT OF THE AMMONIA CONDENSER ON JULY 1,2008 IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE AMOUNT OF THE PAST AMMONIA RELEASE MAY HAVE TOTALED 443 POUNDS PER DAY. THE UNIT WAS ALREADY SHUT DOWN FOR MAINTENANCE WHEN THE REVISED EMISSION AMOUNTS WERE DISCOVERED. THE REMAINING COIL WAS ISOLATED AND THE AMMONIA WAS EVACUATED FROM THE SYSTEM.

CALLER IS REPORTING THAT ON THE 21ST OF THIS MONTH THEY WERE NOTIFIED THAT AN INFECTIOUS PACKAGE WAS MISSING. THE PACKAGE WAS PICKED UP ON JUNE 5 IN SEATTLE, WA AND WAS SUPPOSE TO BE DELIVERED TO THE ALASKA PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT IN ANCHORAGE, AK BY THE 6TH OF JUNE. DUE TO ERRORS ON THE SHIPPING PAPERS, THE PACKAGE WAS STOPPED AT THE LAX GATEWAY AND PUT ON A PLANE HEADED BACK TO SEATTLE, WA. THE LAST KNOWN LOCATION OF THIS PACKAGE WAS IN SEATTLE, WA ON JUNE 15TH. THIS PACKAGE FLEW IN FROM WILMINGTON, OH ON FLIGHT 817, TAIL NUMBER: N745AX. THE DESCRIPTION OF THE PACKAGE IS AS FOLLOWS: A WHITE BOX MEASURING 8" X 9"X 11". PREPRINTED AS QUEST DIAGNOSTICS IN BLACK INK. ONE SIDE HAS THE UN # 2814- INFECTIOUS SUBSTANCE EFFECTING HUMANS. TECHNICAL NAME- PATHOGENIC BACTERIA, PATHOGENIC FUNGUS-SALMONELLA. ON THE OTHER SIDE IS A COMPETENT AUTHORITY LETTER. TOP OF THE BOX SAYS REFRIGERATED.

THE LAST KNOWN LOCATION OF THIS PACKAGE WAS IN SEATTLE, WA ON JUNE 15TH. THIS PACKAGE FLEW IN FROM WILMINGTON, OH ON FLIGHT 817, TAIL NUMBER: N745AX. THE DESCRIPTION OF THE PACKAGE IS AS FOLLOWS: A WHITE BOX MEASURING 8" X 9"X 11". PREPRINTED AS QUEST DIAGNOSTICS IN BLACK INK. ONE SIDE HAS THE UN # 2814- INFECTIOUS SUBSTANCE EFFECTING HUMANS. TECHNICAL NAME- PATHOGENIC BACTERIA, PATHOGENIC FUNGUS-SALMONELLA. ON THE OTHER SIDE IS A COMPETENT AUTHORITY LETTER. TOP OF THE BOX SAYS REFRIGERATED.
